label: 2-4 steps after an early b (original phase)
explanation: Fires during the original (input) phase when the letter b appeared among the first three original tokens, at the steps 2-4 positions after that b (t=2..6, peaking at t=3-4). prev2_tok=b has 14.4x lift and first_tok=b 11.5x. The strongest activations come from sequences that start with b b b: activation is small on the third b (~0.24 of max), then high on the next 2-3 tokens (0.8-1.0), then fades. The identity of the current token barely matters. It does not fire at t=0-1, essentially never at t>=7, never in the copy phase, and only weakly on <DEL> (1% of mass). A b at position 3 or later produces weak or no activation. Missed activations are weak (about 5% of mass), and false positives are mostly near-threshold steps after a single early b. The predicate captures about 95% of mass, but its precision is about 0.72.
